verses.en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.sm: Agaga O lenei, ia outou tumau i le sa‘olotoga ua faasa‘oloto mai ai Keriso ia te i tatou; a E aua neʻi toe taofia outou i le amo o le pologa.

verses.en: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
verses.sm: Faauta mai ea, o aʻu o Paulo, ou te fai atu ia te outou, afai e peritomeina outou, e le aoga lava Keriso ia te outou.

verses.en: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.sm: Ou te toe molitino atu i tagata uma ua peritomeina, ua ia te i latou ona faia o mea uma lava o i le tulafono.

verses.en: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
verses.sm: O outou ua fia maua le ta‘u.miotonuina i le tulafono, ua tete‘a ese lava outou ma Keriso, ua pauu outou nai le alofa tunoa.

verses.en: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
verses.sm: Aua o le Agaga matou te faatalitali atu ai i le faamoemoe i le amiotonu ona o le faatuatua.

verses.en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
verses.sm: Aua e leai se aoga o le peritome po o le le peritomeina i e o ia Keriso Iesu, tau lava o le faatuatua e matua galue i le alofa.

verses.en: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
verses.sm: Sa outou taufetuli lelei; po o ai ea ua faafelavei ia te outou, ia outou le anaana i le upu moni?

verses.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
verses.sm: E le mai le na valaauina outou lenei faaoleole.

verses.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
verses.sm: E faafefeteina le palugá falaoa uma lava i sina mea

verses.en: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
verses.sm: itiiti e faafefete a4. to Ou te matuā faatuatua ia te outou i le Alii, tou te le loto i se tasi mea; a o le na te faaatuatuvaleina outou, e tusa lava po o ai, e faasalaina o ia.

verses.en: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
verses.sm: A o atu, le au uso e, afai ou te talaʻi atu pea le peritome, se a ea le mea e faasauaina ai pea aʻu? Afai o lea, ua faaumatia le mea e tausuai ai ile satauro.

verses.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
verses.sm: O lou manao ia tipieseina i latou e i latou o e faagaeetia outon.

verses.en: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.sm: Aua le au uso e, ua valaautna outou i le sa‘olotoga; tau lava ina neʻi avea le sa‘olotoga ma avanoa mo le tino; a ia outou auauna le tasi i le tasi i le alofa.

verses.en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.sm: Auà ua atoatoa le tulafono uma lava i le upu e tasi, o lenei, la e alofa atu i le lua te tuaoi, ia pei o oe lava ia te oe.

verses.en: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
verses.sm: A e afai tou te feútai ma fe‘ainai, ia outou ina neʻi faaumatia outou ia te outou.

verses.en: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu, ia outou savavali i la le Agaga, ona le faia lea e outou o le tuʻinanau o le tino.

verses.en: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
verses.sm: Ana o le tino ua tu'inanau lea e tetee atu i le Agaga, ua tu‘inanau foi le Agaga e tetee atu i le tino; ua feteeinai foi ia mea, o le mea lea tou te le fai ai mea tou te loto i ai.

verses.en: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
verses.sm: A e afzi e ta‘ita‘iina outou e le Agaga, ua le nonofo outou i le tulafono.

verses.en: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.sm: Ua iloa tino foi galuega a le tino, o mea faapenei; o le faitaaga, o le amio leaga, o le matàitu,

verses.en: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
verses.sm: o le ifo i tupua, o le fai togafiti faatauláitu, o le feitagai, o le femisai, o le losilosi vale, o le lotoa, o le finau vale, o le fevaevaeaiga, o maseiga,

verses.en: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: o le mataua, o le onapa, o le poula, ma mea faapena; ou te muai taʻu atu nei ia te outou, pei ona ou fai atu anamua, o e faia mea faapena, e le fai le malo o le Atua mo latou tofi.

verses.en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.sm: A ole fua o le Agaga o le alofa, o le olioli, o le filemu, o le onosai, o le mataalofa, o le agalelei, o le faamaoni,

verses.en: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.sm: o le agamalu, ma le amio mamá; e le faatulafonoina mea faapena.

verses.en: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
verses.sm: A o e o ia Keriso, ua faasatauroina e i latou le tino, ma ona manao, ma ona tu'inanau.

verses.en: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.sm: Afai ua tatou ola i le Agaga, ia tatou savavali foi i le Agaga.

verses.en: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.sm: Aua neʻi avea i tatou ma e mitamita vale, aua neʻi feluiai, aua, neʻi felosiai.
